## Description

Replace Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer with Npgsql.EntityFrameworkCore.PostgreSQL, Hangfire.SqlServer with Hangfire.PostgreSql and Testcontainers.MsSql with Testcontainers.PostgreSql in `Directory.Packages.props`. docker-compose runs PostgreSQL 17 instead of SQL Server. CI runs the integration tests on Postgres. Replace SQL Server types and functions in the code (rowversion, datetimeoffset, NEWSEQUENTIALID, OPENJSON, HASHBYTES) with Postgres equivalents and keep time in UTC timestamptz and money in integer minor units.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given the solution, when it builds, then no SqlServer package or type remains and warnings stay at zero.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given CI, when it runs, then the integration tests run against PostgreSQL in Testcontainers.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given local services, when they start, then PostgreSQL, Azurite and the email sink come up with one command.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
